messages.author: fc91a1cdf2d9f897
messages.subject: Error when organizing site covariates
parts:
Hi,

I'm getting the following message when attempting to include a list of 16 landcover covariates as siteCovs when creating my unmarkedFrameOccu.  

Error in validObject(.Object) : 
  invalid class “unmarkedFrame” object: invalid object for slot "siteCovs" in class "unmarkedFrame": got class "list", should be or extend class "optionalDataFrame"

My landcover covariates are arranged as matrices prior to running the model code below. I have included presence/absence as my y as a matrix and date as the only matrix for obsCovs.  I feel I'm missing something with how my landcover covariates are organized.  

Any thoughts would be great!  Thanks!

Dan 

UPSA_obs.covs<-list(date2)
UPSA_obs.covs

UPSA_site.covs<-list(Water2,Exposed2,Urban2,Shrubland2,Wetland2,Grassland2,Pasture2,Wheat2,Corn2,Canola2,Soybean2,Coniferous2,Broadleaf2,Mixed2,Oats2,Fallow2)
UPSA_site.covs

names(UPSA_obs.covs) <- c("Date")

names(UPSA_site.covs) <- c("Water","Exposed","Urban","Shrubland","Wetland","Grassland","Pasture","Wheat","Corn","Canola","Soybean","Coniferous","Broadleaf","Mixed","Oats","Fallow")

UPSA_umf_mod_date_visits135 <- unmarkedFrameOccu(y=pres_abse, siteCovs=UPSA_site.covs, 
                                                 obsCovs=UPSA_obs.covs)   # organize data                                               # ***(ERROR occurs here when organizing the data) ***
UPSA_umf_mod_date_visits135                   # look at data
summary(UPSA_umf_mod_date_visits135)            # summarize      
UPSA_occu_mod_date_visits135 <- occu(~ Date ~ 1, UPSA_umf_mod_date_visits135)  # fit a model
summary(UPSA_occu_mod_date_visits135)

messages.author: 1bbd1bb312ff7417
messages.subject: Re: Error when organizing site covariates
parts:
Hi Dan,

For the function unmarkedFrameOccu, the argument siteCovs needs to be provided in the form of data frame, not list.
You can try to use the following code instead:

UPSA_site.covs<-data.frame(Water=Water2,Exposed=Exposed2,Urban=Urban2,
                                               Shrubland=Shrubland2,Wetland=Wetland2,Grassland=Grassland2,
                                               Pasture=Pasture2,Wheat=Wheat2,Corn=Corn2,
                                               Canola=Canola2,Soybean=Soybean2,Coniferous=Coniferous2,
                                               Broadleaf=Broadleaf2,Mixed=Mixed2,Oats=Oats2,Fallow=Fallow2)
